title: Product metadata
description: Product cover and display values stored directly in Product.metadata.

kitchenPrintEnabled.title: Kitchen print enabled
kitchenPrintEnabled.description: Controls whether this product is included in kitchen printing.

soldout.title: Kitchen and ordering sold out
soldout.description: Marks this product as sold out in kitchen and ordering screens.

listOrder.title: Kitchen display order
listOrder.description: Lower values appear earlier in the kitchen product list.

startSaleTime.title: Sale start time
startSaleTime.description: Daily sale start time in HH:mm format. Leave both sale times empty for no time restriction.

endSaleTime.title: Sale end time
endSaleTime.description: Daily sale end time in HH:mm format. Leave both sale times empty for no time restriction.
